info.title: eRecycleHub mobile API
info.description: Contract: docs/API_REQUIREMENTS.md. Every response is { success, message, data } or { success: false, message, errorCode, errors }. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (from /api/v1/auth/login or /register) and `lang: en|ar`. Live bids: wss://<host>/api/ws/auctions/{id}.

post.summary: Sign in with e-mail and password
post.description: 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS for a wrong e-mail or password; 429 RATE_LIMITED after 5 failures (15-minute lock).
`phone` is a Jordanian mobile number (+9627XXXXXXXX) or, from Forgot password, an e-mail address. Answers the same for known and unknown targets. 5 codes per target per hour.
422 INVALID_OTP when wrong or expired (5 wrong tries burn the code). `resetToken` is set when an account exists for the phone/e-mail; send it to /auth/password/reset.
`type` is always Customer. Requires a code for `phone` verified in the last 30 minutes (422 OTP_NOT_VERIFIED otherwise). Duplicate e-mail/phone: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED with `errors`.

post.summary: Set a new password with the resetToken from /auth/otp/verify
post.description: Signs the account out everywhere. 422 INVALID_RESET_TOKEN when missing, used or expired (1 hour).
Also forgets the push token registered by this session.

get.description: Fixed ids: 1 About, 2 Terms, 3 Privacy, 4 Payment. A page with no content yet is left out.

post.description: Upsert; re-sending the same token is fine. platform: android | ios (optional). deviceId (optional, max 100): a new token with the same deviceId replaces that device's old token. The backend subscribes the token to the topics of the auctions you take part in; the app does not. Logout forgets the token.

get.description: Public files need no token (the app's image loader and WebView do not send one). Private files are served to their owner only; anything else is 404.

get.summary: Every visible auction that has not ended (no paging; the app filters and sorts). Ended auctions are only returned in /profile/auctions (won) and favourites, and by id
Auctions grouped by status, in tab order: All, Active, Upcoming, Expired. Ended auctions are not returned, so Expired is always empty

get.description: isLeading: you hold the highest bid. heldByViewer: what your leading bid holds (0 if none). debitsWallet: wallet bidding is on. wallet: your available balance (when wallet bidding is on). isWinner: the auction ended, was not voided, and you hold the winning bid. saleStatus (ended auctions with bids, else null): Paid | PaymentFailed | Pending | Voided | NotCharged; only the holder of the winning bid sees PaymentFailed, Voided or NotCharged, everyone else sees Paid or Pending.

post.summary: Place a bid; returns the full auction details
post.description: When the server runs with Bidding__DebitWallet=true a bid HOLDS its amount: the wallet balance and ledger are not touched, the previous leader's hold is released, and the money is charged only if you win when the auction ends. The response also carries availableAfter (your available balance right after this bid) and releasedFromPrevious (the hold released from the previous leader, 0 if none), plus isLeading, heldByViewer and debitsWallet. The wallet field of the returned auction is then your available balance (balance minus pending withdrawals minus the money held by your leading bids). You may lead several auctions while the sum of your holds fits it. Errors: 409 AUCTION_CLOSED (auction ended, inactive or deactivated; = AUCTION_ENDED), 409 AUCTION_NOT_STARTED, 409 OUTBID (someone bid first: reload), 422 BID_TOO_LOW, 422 INSUFFICIENT_WALLET (= INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: your available balance cannot cover the hold; the message states required and available; also returned when it is below the auction's insurance), 403 BID_NOT_ALLOWED (own auction, administrator or blocked account). Listeners of /api/ws/auctions/{id} get bid.placed with the same bid id.
Idempotent. 404 when the auction does not exist.

put.description: Does not change the photo (POST /profile/image). Taken e-mail/phone: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.

delete.description: Removes personal data, ends every session and push token. 409 ACCOUNT_DELETE_BLOCKED while the account has a wallet balance, a pending withdrawal or money held by a leading bid (the message and arguments say how much): withdraw or use the money first.

post.description: multipart/form-data with the image in part `file` (JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP; 10 MB at most). Saved on the account at once.
Wrong current password: 422 INVALID_CREDENTIALS (not 401). This device stays signed in; other devices are signed out.

get.description: live: running auctions you bid on. won: ended auctions where your bid was highest.
type: Deposit | Withdraw. status: Pending | Completed | Rejected | Reversed.

balance = money in the wallet. pendingWithdrawals = withdrawal requests awaiting approval. held = money reserved by your leading bids (only when wallet bidding is on). available = balance - pendingWithdrawals - held: what can be bid or withdrawn.
Every balance change, newest first. amount is signed (negative = money out). balanceBefore is null on entries older than this field. pageSize max 100.

post.description: Creates a Pending deposit; an administrator credits the wallet after the bank transfer arrives and you get a push and an in-app notification (topup_approved / topup_rejected). At most 5 requests (deposits and withdrawals together) can be Pending at once: 409 WALLET_TOO_MANY_PENDING. Optional Idempotency-Key header (max 100 chars): a retry with the same key returns the same request instead of creating another; 409 wallet.idempotency_key_reused if the key belongs to a different kind of request.

Creates a Pending withdrawal; the balance is debited when an administrator approves it. 422 INSUFFICIENT_WALLET when the amount exceeds the available balance (balance - pending withdrawals - held). Approval later re-checks the same figure and notifies you (withdrawal_approved / withdrawal_rejected). Optional Idempotency-Key header: a retry with the same key and amount returns the same request; 409 wallet.idempotency_key_reused otherwise.

get.description: Newest first, at most 500 (optional unread=true, page, pageSize). type: auction | bid | wallet | system. kind is the exact event (the push `type` with the same name); auctionId says which auction to open. Each push carries notification_id = id of the row here, so a push and its row are one notification.

delete.description: Soft delete: POST /notifications/{id}/restore undoes it within 24 hours.
